entities.summary: Terje Tysland (b. 1951-04-14, Namsos Municipality) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Namsos Municipality and Norway. Known in the fields of norway, composers & musicians, europe.
